name: Northern Rivers

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A New South Wales zone of about 16,700 square miles, with Hastings River as its one region. It has only about 100 acres of vines, led by Semillon at 29 percent.
